name: Causing Another To Stumble
overview: Scripture sternly warns against causing others, especially believers, to stumble in their faith, emphasizing the severe consequences for those who do so, as illustrated by the imagery of a millstone around the neck and being cast into the sea (Matthew 18:6; Mark 9:42). Jesus acknowledges that offenses will inevitably occur but pronounces woe on those through whom they come (Luke 17:1). Believers are called to receive those weak in faith without judgment and to avoid placing stumbling blocks in their path, underscoring the responsibility to protect and build up the body of Christ rather than hinder it (Romans 14:1, 14:13).
